edits.before: An internal application queries a DynamoDB GSI by status. The GSI uses KEYS_ONLY, and shipmentDate, which the screen must display, is not a key. The existing GSI definition cannot be changed. The application must obtain the latest date for each item found by the search from the base table record and return it to the screen. Which approach works?

Which approach works?
